thread:
maya_pm: quick decision needed — AEs are promising higher SLA (priority routing / lower p50) to a few onramp customers with no commit. can we allow exceptions? @jordan_sales
jordan_sales: we need temporary priority lanes for 3 pilots — they'll sign if we can prove perf. 60d trial sounds fine. need price uplift or deposit?
maya_pm: thinking about an 'onramp-exemption' flow: default 30d, usage cap, auto-expire, finance approval. what are the constraints from eng/finance/legal?
omar_finance: can't do open-ended capacity. prefer either a refundable deposit or a fixed price uplift while the exemption is active. + we need a billing code so we can track refunds.
tess_eng: tech-wise this is routing tag + quota enforcement. doable, but risk of SLO impact for paying customers if we don't enforce circuit breakers. need monitoring and an emergency revoke path.
sam_se: for pilots we can offer ephemeral 'priority-burst' add-on or spin up dedicated trial nodes. shorter path is a routing tag + quota limit tied to account.
lina_legal: any exception needs an addendum: term, automatic expiry, explicit rollback/rescind clause, and data/telemetry consent. prefer templated clause.
jordan_sales: deposit ok — AE asks for an easy UI toggle so we can enable during negotiation and show clear expiry to customers.
maya_pm: proposed policy (sketch):
```
onramp_exemption:
  duration_days: 30
  token_cap_per_day: 1000000
  price_uplift_pct: 60
  auto_revoke: true
  approval_flow: [sales, finance, legal]
```
thoughts?
tess_eng: that's fine as a start. implementation plan: (1) routing tag + quota enforcement (2w), (2) UI toggle + audit logs (1w), (3) telemetry + alerts (ongoing). we need a sprint slot and an ops playbook for revoke.
omar_finance: confirm we'll own the deposit accounting and refund path. also need SLA exceptions to be time-boxed in billing.
lina_legal: will draft a 1-paragraph addendum template (48h) that auto-terminates and includes rollback and liability cap language.
maya_pm: decision: pilot agreed. action items: @tess produce tech spec by 2412380000, @lina produce addendum template, @omar define deposit and uplift numbers, @jordan shortlist 3 pilot accounts and readiness criteria. pilot limited to 3 accounts, max 30d unless extended by exec signoff. review in 48h. :white_check_mark:
jordan_sales: sending shortlist today.
tess_eng: starting tech spec, will include circuit breaker thresholds and monitoring dashboard queries. will call out required infra changes.
deploy-bot: reminder — if pilot impacts SLO, open #pilot-onramp-incident and notify eng-oncall.
maya_pm: thanks all — we'll treat this as a time-limited experiment; if signals look good we will bake it into packaging (as an official "priority trial" add-on).
summary: Decision to pilot a time-limited onramp exemption flow (routing tag + quota + addendum). Action items assigned to eng, legal, finance, and sales.
